title: 2026-11-16_Sofacy_Malware_Investigation_c6c
description: Investigate a compromised Linux host infected with the Sofacy malware family, specifically the Fysbis backdoor. Identify and analyze suspicious activities, including C2 communication, data collection, and lateral movement.

levels.title: Sofacy Malware Investigation
levels.content: Investigate a compromised Linux host infected with the Sofacy malware family, specifically the Fysbis backdoor. Identify and analyze suspicious activities, including C2 communication, data collection, and lateral movement.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Use SSH to connect to the target host with the provided credentials. Username: user, Password: password. Enter 'start' to begin.
levels.local_content: Use SSH to connect to the target host with the provided credentials. Username: user, Password: password. Enter 'start' to begin.

levels.title: Suspicious C2 Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, list all services, including inactive ones, and then list all service unit files. Finally, identify the suspicious service by listing all running services.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the list of running services for any unfamiliar entries.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running' to identify the suspicious service.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution: To determine the network port associated with the suspicious communication, inspect the suspicious service configuration, check the status of the suspicious service, and list all network listeners.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Inspect the service configuration for the port number.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the status of the suspicious service for additional details.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'ss -tulnp' to list all network listeners.

levels.title: Suspicious Data Collection Service Discovery
levels.content: System information appears to be collected automatically without an authorized administrative purpose. Investigate the host and identify the service responsible for this activity.
levels.solution: To identify the service responsible for the suspicious data collection activity, list all services, including inactive ones, list all service unit files, list all timers, and inspect the suspicious timer configuration.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the list of timers for any unfamiliar entries.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers --all' to identify the suspicious timer.
